# L’Ayalga

> An AI hospitality coordinator for shared homes: informal invitations become conflict-aware visits, with human approval for social exceptions and proactive reconfirmation.

This index links to public Markdown on the repository's production branch, main.
The guides distinguish implementation, local scripted tests, dated deployment
evidence, and remaining limitations. L’Ayalga began as an AWS Agents for Humans
hackathon entry; judging closed on 2026-10-14, and the submission material is
archived. The archive describes the hackathon demo, not current behavior.

## Product

- [Product overview and local setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/README.md): Audience, behavior, setup, and disclosure.
- [Host manual](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/guides/host-manual.md): Google sign-in, adding hosts and rooms, decisions, follow-up, and recovery.
- [Guest manual](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/guides/guest-manual.md): Invitation links, room choice, requests, reminders, changes, and cancellation.
- [Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/roadmap.md): Released work, the real-use launch, and remaining work.

## Architecture

- [Architecture explanation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/architecture/README.md): Trust boundaries and links to text diagram sources.
- [Runtime topology source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/architecture/layalga-architecture.mmd): Mermaid source for the selected execution path.
- [Data lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/security/data-lifecycle.md): Retention, prompt handling, memory, and disclosure boundaries.

## Optional

- [Hackathon archive](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/archive/hackathon/README.md): The judge guide, evidence index, Strands inventory, system guide, and submission copy as of 2026-10-14.
- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juan294/layalga/main/docs/README.md): Guides, decisions, operations, and dated development history.
